task: [.github/workflows/auto-merge-gate.yml] .github/workflows/auto-merge-gate.yml dosyasinda tespit edilen 151 saniyelik medyan sureyi dusurmek amaciyla; pip ve apt paket indirmelerine actions/cache adimi eklenerek tekrarlayan paket kurulumlari engellenmeli, ilgisiz kod degisikliklerinde calismayi önlemek adina push ve pull_request tetikleyicilerine paths filtreleri tanimlanmali ve birbirine bagimliligi olmayan test adimlari ayri job'lara bolunerek paralel calismalari saglanmalidir.

evidence.description: Target GitHub Actions workflow configuration identified for optimization to lower the 151-second median runtime.

factual_findings: .github/workflows/auto-merge-gate.yml currently executes without path filters on 'push' and 'pull_request' triggers, triggering unnecessary builds on unrelated documentation or configuration changes.
.github/workflows/auto-merge-gate.yml lacks 'actions/cache' steps for pip and apt package managers, resulting in redundant downloads on every workflow invocation.
Independent test steps in .github/workflows/auto-merge-gate.yml run sequentially within a single job rather than executing concurrently across separate jobs.
hypotheses: Integrating 'actions/cache' for apt and pip packages in .github/workflows/auto-merge-gate.yml will substantially decrease setup overhead.
Defining trigger 'paths' filters in .github/workflows/auto-merge-gate.yml will prevent execution on irrelevant file modifications.
Decomposing independent pipeline steps into parallel GitHub Actions jobs in .github/workflows/auto-merge-gate.yml will lower total end-to-end duration below the 151-second median threshold.
result.recommendation: Refactor .github/workflows/auto-merge-gate.yml to include 'paths' filters for 'push' and 'pull_request' triggers, insert 'actions/cache' for pip and apt installations, and split non-dependent test commands into parallel jobs.
result.next_action: Modify .github/workflows/auto-merge-gate.yml to implement path filtering, apt/pip caching steps, and parallel job architecture.
